description: This file implements a service for retrieving total language model (LLM) costs aggregated by agent name within a backend system. It includes functions to determine the relevant database collection, construct aggregation pipelines for different data schemas, fallback in-memory aggregation, and exposes a primary function to fetch the costs by agent. The code handles schema variations and includes environment-based configurations, logging, and data normalization.

methods.name: resolveCollectionCandidates()
methods.description: Resolves the collection names to query based on environment variables and defaults, prioritizing 'llm-costs' and other common names.

methods.name: buildFlatAgentCostPipeline()
methods.description: Builds an aggregation pipeline for flat schema documents to compute total costs per agent, normalizing agent names and handling various cost structures.

methods.name: buildAgentsArrayPipeline()
methods.description: Constructs an aggregation pipeline for documents where agents and costs are stored in an Agents array field.

methods.name: aggregateAgentsInApp(documents = [])
methods.description: Provides an in-process fallback aggregation for environments without server-side support, working over an array of documents with agent-cost data.

methods.name: getLlmCostByAgent()
methods.description: Main exported function that attempts to retrieve aggregated LLM costs by agent from the database, falling back to in-memory aggregation if necessary.
